reviews.title: Good quality especially for price point!
reviews.comment: Comfortable with a good quality microphone! I've only used them while plugged in but the cord is decently long. I only hear slightly muffled noises while they are on and design wise they are as shown.
reviews.author: allyson munz

reviews.title: Corsair will always be a solid headset brand
reviews.comment: As the title states I’ve gotten Corsair exclusively over the years, will never change. Sounds great bass noise and the sharper gaming noises like twigs snapping in Hunt Showdown. Corsair is never uncomfortable the headsets have always been nice to wear. The microphone from what I can tell, sounds good. I recommend Corsair to office workers for their nice mousepads and to gamers for their headsets.
reviews.author: Kane C

reviews.title: Excellent for the price point!
reviews.comment: Great as a second pair when my son has friends over. He can't tell the difference between this set and the one we paid $200+ for. I would definitely order this again.
reviews.author: Elizabeth Byers

reviews.title: Worth about $20 It's a cheap budget headset at a higher price
reviews.comment:
Everything about this headset screams cheap and flimsy. Sound is meh. Bass is terrible, microphone is subpar. Cannot recommend it at all unless you find it for $20 or less and don't expect it to last a year.
Bad build quality, Uncomfortable, Hurts the top of your head in about 20 minutes of wear.
reviews.author: L. Frazier

reviews.title: My Thoughts and Experience.
reviews.comment:
the sound quality of these are really good, maybe even great. it can have a little bit more bass than the Razer Barracuda X if you equalize it right - i know because i have that headset as well.
unfortunately, i have weird ears that prevent me from using this headset because the antihelix of my ear (i think that's what it's called, look it up) pops out too much. so as soon as i put them on i can feel the hard plastic wall of the speaker touching my ear and that feeling has always bothered the **** out of me.
so if you have ears like mine, these are not for you. you will need something that looks like it has more cushion and space between the speaker and where the ear should be. it's perfect for kids in my opinion.
reviews.author: Jose
